source: PostgreSQL commit with synchronous_commit=on; external batch intent/ACK journal and transactional receipts
replication: Kafka RF3/minISR2; Doris RF3 across three BEs; PostgreSQL and shared Flink checkpoint volume are single local storage domains
cdc: Debezium at-least-once; Flink PK changelog normalization enabled; regular current-table join, no state TTL

sinks.asynchronous: batch sink, at-least-once with unique-key/sequence idempotency

correctness: Exact ordered full-body comparison with a quiescent PostgreSQL snapshot; every retained batch receipt reconciled
deletes: Physical source deletes and cancellation-filter retractions must disappear from both sinks
retry: No blind retry of an ambiguous source commit. Reconcile transaction receipt and external intent first
isolation: All services private local Docker network; no cloud endpoints/configuration/credentials
limits: No global exactly-once/linearizability proof; no independent-host or power-loss durability claim; no saturation/long soak
